library(tidyverse)
survey_filtered <- read.csv(
  "KFC_Survey_RStudio_Filtered_Eaters.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA")
)

# Identify survey response columns
response_columns <- survey_filtered %>%
  select(-respondent_id) %>%
  names()

# Count missing responses
survey_filtered <- survey_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    missing_count = rowSums(
      is.na(across(all_of(response_columns)))
    )
  )

# Count skipped or declined responses
survey_filtered <- survey_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    skipped_count = rowSums(
      across(
        all_of(response_columns),
        ~ str_detect(
          coalesce(as.character(.x), ""),
          regex(
            "Skip this question|Prefer not to say",
            ignore_case = TRUE
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )

# Calculate total unanswered questions
survey_filtered <- survey_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    unanswered_total = missing_count + skipped_count
  )

# Keep respondents with no more than 50% unanswered
survey_final <- survey_filtered %>%
  filter(unanswered_total <= 44) %>%
  select(-missing_count, -skipped_count, -unanswered_total)

# Check the final data
dim(survey_final)

View(survey_final)

survey_final %>%
  #filter(restaurant_factor_kfc != "I almost never eat here") |> 
  count(weekly_eating_out_breakfast, sort = TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(weekly_eating_out_breakfast, n),
    y = n
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") 


survey_final %>%
  filter(weekly_eating_out_lunch != "Almost never",  monthly_frequency_kfc != "Almost never") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = monthly_frequency_kfc)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal()

  filter(weekly_eating_out_breakfast != "Almost never", monthly_frequency_kfc != "Almost never") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = monthly_frequency_kfc)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal()

  ggplot(aes(x = monthly_frequency_kfc)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal()

    y = "Number of Respondents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
